source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique common TBD identity; OOB history establishes read-only App 0x06/0x4A.

source_snapshot.procedure: During Test TBD; generic clear-logs pre-step.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED but treats payload as firmware state.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: OOB review identifies standard 0x4A session-payload status read.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 makes payload scope a Project input.

original_test_intent: Read activation status for approved IPMI session payload types/instances without activating, deactivating or changing sessions.
original_method: Use Project-selected protected transport and standard App 0x06/0x4A with approved scope and full activation-state/port parsing.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies the approved payload type/instance and expected state once; bounded status reads require no action confirmation.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Too conservative once standard 0x4A history is considered.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected raw 0x06 0x4A with pinned field parser and no control follow-on.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Read approved payload status, validate length/fields/active instances and ports, compare expected state and route cleanup separately.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds standard read guidance without Master edits.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Misread status can hide a live management payload.

project_override_considerations: Alternate readers need equivalent type/instance/port state and must not auto-clean.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master is TBD and exact GPT V2 miscasts session-payload status as firmware activation status; context/OOB history resolves the read method only in Review guidance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Standard 0x4A defines the core read; scope/parser/reference are Project inputs.

review_improvement: Corrects payload semantics and prevents status discovery from triggering automatic cleanup.
independent_technical_reasoning: In IPMI Messaging context this is a standard session-payload status read, not firmware-image health. It is deterministic and non-mutating after scope/parser inputs, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE is justified.
